title: Push notifications not delivered on Android 15
text:
On Android 15 the app never asks for the POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission, so students on newer phones get no pushes at all (new group, session reminders).

**Steps**

1. Install on an Android 15 device
2. Join a group, have another member post a message
3. No notification and no permission prompt

Sam is on it. Needs a permission prompt at a sensible moment (after joining the first group, not at first launch) plus a settings link if the student denied it.

Blocks the waiting list notifications.
